author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Reviewed 48px light/dark: two mirrored bean kidneys with a hilum notch, ureters curving into a tapered bladder with urethra; symmetric, smooth cubic joins.
omissions: Ureters leave the kidneys' lower inner edge rather than mid-notch (8-unit clearance to the lower lobe); ureters shortened to fit the bladder.
lucide_reference: No direct Lucide match; smooth closed-cubic bean construction
